outputIntent: Turn one verified subject into an information-rich editorial profile whose mechanism, evidence, callouts, and rating can be understood without narration.
positioning: Not a specimen collection card, sales poster, or decorative fact sheet; it is an authored modern encyclopedia plate with real teaching value.
contentSchema: callouts tied to real subject features

layoutFamilies.topology: hero subject occupies the left 42%; a vertical mechanism spine and three unequal evidence modules occupy the right; score strip closes above the safe band
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: editorial medium view with one macro inset and one diagram scale
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one hero, one mechanism, two callouts, one evidence module, one score strip

layoutFamilies.topology: central evidence object with two magnified cutaways, one comparison rail, and one compact conclusion module
layoutFamilies.readingPath: evidence object -> cutaway A -> cutaway B -> conclusion
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: high three-quarter editorial cutaway with tactile paper-layer depth
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one evidence object, two cutaways, one comparison, one conclusion

physicalVisualSystem.material: warm uncoated encyclopedia paper, precise naturalist illustration, crisp ink edges, subtle print grain, shallow paper-layer relief
physicalVisualSystem.lighting: large soft daylight from upper left, gentle fill, restrained contact shadows only under overlapping modules
physicalVisualSystem.color: warm ivory, graphite, muted sage, and one evidence-specific ochre accent
physicalVisualSystem.typography: editorial Chinese hierarchy with a strong title zone, compact labels, tabular numerals, and no decorative fake copy

forbiddenElements: rating markers that cannot be counted
callout lines that miss their named feature
qcAssertions: every module teaches a supplied fact
rating number and visible markers agree exactly
detail insets belong to the hero subject
callouts terminate on the named feature
subject and every module remain above the subtitle-safe band
